verdict.rationale: Alacritty's first-party docs describe built-in scrollback search: forward with Ctrl+Shift+F (Cmd+F on macOS), backward with Ctrl+Shift+B (Cmd+B), and vi-mode `/` and `?` search. Bindable SearchStart/SearchEnd actions let you jump to a match's start or end. Missing for 10: the docs never explicitly name next/previous-match keys or describe performance on large buffers, and no independent or hands-on evidence corroborates the search workflow.
